summary: Christian Catalini appears in Part 5 of The Buildout. Part 5: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business. Argued in Part 5 (Anthropic: not yet).

parts.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Are Not the Same Business

mentions.excerpt: Christian Catalini’s Some Simple Economics of Open versus Closed AI supplies the logic.

sides.claim: Training runs account for only 10 to 23 percent of AI labs' total compute costs, with the remainder tied to tacit knowledge in data curation, infrastructure, and learning from failed experiments.

The demand curve for AI capabilities is heterogeneous: commodity intelligence will become price-competitive across many applications, while convex-payoff domains like finance and frontier research can sustain premium pricing for marginal capability…
